dish.title: Jamaican Ital Stew with Squash, Kidney Beans, and Coconut
dish.description: Butternut squash, sweet potato, carrots, okra, and red kidney beans simmered in coconut milk with onion, garlic, ginger, scallions, thyme, allspice, and a whole scotch bonnet, finished with spinach.

recipe_version.title: Jamaican Ital Stew with Squash, Kidney Beans, and Coconut
recipe_version.description: Butternut squash, sweet potato, carrots, okra, and red kidney beans simmered in coconut milk with onion, garlic, ginger, scallions, thyme, allspice, and a whole scotch bonnet, finished with spinach.

ingredients.name: coconut milk
ingredients.display_name: full-fat coconut milk (one 13.5-oz can) whose label lists coconut, water, and guar gum

ingredients.name: red kidney beans
ingredients.display_name: red kidney beans (one 15-oz can) whose label lists beans, water, and salt

steps.title: Prep
steps.body: Chop the onion, mince the garlic, grate the ginger, and slice the scallions, keeping whites and greens apart. Peel and cut the squash and sweet potato into 1 1/2-inch chunks, slice the carrots, and trim and cut the okra. Drain and rinse the beans.

steps.title: Aromatics
steps.body: Heat the oil in the 5.5-quart Dutch oven over medium, about 1 minute. Cook the onion and scallion whites until soft, about 5 minutes, then the garlic, ginger, thyme, and allspice for 1 minute.

steps.title: Simmer
steps.body: Add the squash, sweet potato, carrots, coconut milk, 2 cups water, salt, and the whole scotch bonnet. Bring to a simmer, about 6 minutes, then cover and simmer gently until the squash is just tender, about 20 minutes.

steps.title: Finish
steps.body: Add the beans and okra and simmer uncovered until the okra is tender and the broth thickens slightly, about 10 minutes. Stir in the spinach until wilted, about 1 minute.

steps.title: Serve
steps.body: Lift out the scotch bonnet and thyme stems. Ladle into bowls and scatter with the scallion greens.

coverage_contribution: Jamaica has escovitch fish and jerk pork in the catalog; there is no Rastafarian ital cooking and no coconut vegetable stew without curry paste. An easy vegan HH001 dinner.
near_duplicate_review: Compared with coconut-chickpea-curry: a thyme-allspice coconut stew of squash, beans, and okra, not a curry-spiced chickpea curry. Compared with thai-red-curry-kabocha: no curry paste, fish sauce, or tofu; Jamaican aromatics and kidney beans. Compared with ghanaian-red-red-plantains: a coconut vegetable stew, not palm-oil black-eyed peas with plantains.
not_duplicate_of: Not rice and peas (no rice) and not a curry.
